name: PartHive
description: Import EasyEDA/JLCPCB (LCSC) parts into a KiCad library
description_full:
PartHive imports a part's symbol, footprint and 3D model from EasyEDA / JLCPCB (LCSC) by its part number (e.g. C25804) into a local KiCad library, links them together, and registers the libraries in KiCad.

Libraries can be registered globally (all projects) or as project libraries (the project's own sym-lib-table / fp-lib-table, using ${KIPRJMOD} paths so the project stays portable). The choice is remembered per project, and two KiCad windows with different projects each keep their own.

Project libraries can be pinned at the top of KiCad's Add Symbol / Add Footprint lists automatically.

Each symbol gets an 'LCSC Part #' field (the C number) and a 'JLCPCB Link' field (the JLCPCB part link).

Bundles the AGPL-3.0 converter easyeda2kicad_ph (a fork of uPesy/easyeda2kicad.py).
